style: Say with lively energy, like a friendly game show host
lines: Read the message. Hover a link to see where it really goes. Then press Keep or Report.
Now tap the part that gave it away. Then press Done.
Sixty seconds. Keep the real ones, report the fakes, and tap the tell for double points. Press Start round.
Time! Check your score and the tells you caught. Press Play again for another round.
These are the eight tells. Tap an example to try that message.
Keep or Report. A report needs one tell for double points.
Tap one tell in the message. Your first spot is your answer.
Keep or Report can answer the next message now.
Check the known addresses. Then press Back to message.
Choose No to keep your best score, or Yes, clear best to remove it.
